finding.title: The production build tried to trace the whole workspace
finding.foundBy: The first production build after adding the cloud adapter
finding.symptom: Turbopack warned that the dynamic runtime-data path caused the whole project to be traced into server output.
finding.cause: The development database path was resolved from an environment variable. Static build analysis could not determine which runtime files it needed.
finding.fix: Tell Turbopack not to trace the runtime-data path. Cloud deployments use managed storage, so local development data is not a build dependency.
finding.verification: A second npm run build succeeded without the tracing warning. No deployment or credential exposure was observed.
finding.learningExercise: Explain the difference between application assets that belong in a deployment and mutable data that belongs in a persistent storage service.

verification.result: 19 backend and deployment-configuration tests passed; TypeScript passed; the optimized production build passed without warnings.
verification.scope: Real local Better Auth sessions, SQLite transactions, image processing, isolation, hidden content, concurrency, and deployment configuration. PostgreSQL/Supabase Storage adapters, Google OAuth, verification emails, and password reset are implemented but require real environment configuration and a live deployment check. Cloud provider login and email delivery have not been verified.
